description: An eighth of the way from the top, a wavy stroke with five peaks and four valleys. A blue block covers the paper an eighth of the way up from the bottom. At the top center of the block of blue, is a vertical rectangle, in the shape of a door. This artwork has *Untitled (Patio Door)*, 1970s (cat. no. 1688) on the back.
